AboutPage.intro: Software engineer with a double Master's degree from ESILV (Paris) and Politecnico di Torino (Turin). I build across mobile, web, and backend infrastructure — always with the same baseline: clean architecture, testable code, and no technical debt left behind.

entries.description: Built a Flutter mobile application for endurance athletes, visualizing physiological data collected from wearable devices. Integrated a microservices backend and set up automated CI/CD pipelines. Maintained a strong focus on test coverage and clean architecture — the codebase was handed off to a PhD student with zero onboarding friction.

Designed and developed a distributed car rental system using Spring Boot microservices and React. Implemented fleet management, reservations, and PayPal payments with transactional consistency via Kafka and the Outbox pattern. Secured the architecture with Keycloak (OAuth2/OIDC) and an API Gateway. Led a distributed international team as Scrum Master, running two-week iterations and improving estimation accuracy.

Developed a Flutter mobile app for self-guided geography field trips, integrating Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore, and interactive maps. Worked in a fully English-speaking, multinational team. The defining lesson: understanding the user's real workflow matters more than technical optimization — professors needed to stay inside QGIS, their existing tool, not learn a new interface.
